steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Silence! Finally! Ever since I entered the city I've been wondering when I would get to see you...

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Um... S-Silence?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Ifrit, come over here.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Don't worry, Silence. I'm all good here, good enough to knock out a row of bad guys while carrying you in one arm and running laps around them! If you don't believe me, I'll even carry Saria with my other arm just to prove it! Ha... haha...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Stop speaking for a bit, you'll affect the drone readings.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Oh... okay.
Silence lowers her head to examine Ifrit, just like she used to do, with the same meticulous and gentle manner as ever, but Ifrit still feels very nervous.
She has never been scared of Silence getting angry at her.
One of the first things she learned growing up was that Silence's anger stemmed from a concern for her.
She knows that after Silence is angry, she helps her take care of the things that were doing her harm, and helps her chase off the things that were scaring her.
It was not real anger.
But Ifrit is scared of this silent Silence.
When Silence does not show an ounce of anger, and rather, is quieter than usual, she realizes—
Something must have hit Silence's limit.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: The skies in Trimounts are always gloomy and grey, and the storm clouds are as big as monsters. No wonder you used to always walk into my room with your hair all drenched.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Oh, and 'hot dogs,' do you like 'em? The Doctor bought some for me and Rosmontis, and I wanna try one with strawberry-flavored syrup next time.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Silence...

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: I decided to come here myself. I bothered Dr. Kal'tsit about it for a long time, and also wrote the Doctor a super long letter.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: I completed all my courses and trainings in the last few years, I can do a whole lot of missions, just like you and Saria...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Blood Originium-Crystal Density has slightly increased.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: What are the estimated rates of increase for that and for Cell-Fusion Assimilation?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: For now, they're within controllable ranges.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: We won't know the rest of the results until Ifrit returns to the landship for a comprehensive examination.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: You want me to return to the landship... you guys still don't trust me...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: No, Ifrit. I trust you.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: There shouldn't be a need for any 'buts' here with Saria around!

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Four years ago, it was in this very city, and under the very same signboard.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I almost lost you forever. Back then, she was at your side too, no different than right now.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: But I lived, and I've been living good! Saria protected me, so this time I can protect you and everyone with her!

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Ifrit, listen to Silence. She's your doctor, and you should trust her the most.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: But I trust you too! I trust the Doctor, and Rosmontis too, there's no difference in the amount of trust I have in you guys.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Saria, I saw you the other day. You were with that mysterious man in a trenchcoat, at Triton Factory in District 13. And on the very same day, something fell from the sky.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: So you were there too.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Just another Rhine-related secret experiment, right?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Of course you won't answer. Because... this is you trying to 'protect' me and Ifrit.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Just ten minutes ago, Ifrit stopped an assassination attempt on the Vice President.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: I'm not trying to conceal information from you, Silence, but what I have on hand is also very limited. There are simply too many different factions involved in this, and all I can do is try my best to prevent the situation from deteriorating even further.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: 'We must put this back on the right track'—I've heard that line from Director Saria too many times.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: You were always in control of the situation back at Rhine Lab, but those horrifying experiments kept popping up, one after another.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: There will always be someone hurt by the ambitions of another, and these wounds won't simply be healed by criminal charges and trials... Not to mention, a trial that should never have happened in the first place.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I can't help but wonder... when you people finally extinguish this fire, just how many will be left lying in the ruins, breathing their last breaths just like Ifrit was?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: You perceive the situation more thoroughly and clearly than I can.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: But you still choose out of habit, to help them 'control.' You hope to minimize any damage, and preferably, shrink it until it becomes unnoticeable, rather than put a stop to the immorality at its source.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: I can't deny that.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Saria... I've been waiting years to ask you a question.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Your inability to make a genuine stand against Rhine, is it because deep in your bones, you've always been the same as them...? The same as Control?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Sniper!

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Silence, get down! Ifrit—

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: What—

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: S... Saria...?
White calcium crystals float before her eyes.
They had briefly protected her and Ifrit just moments ago, but now they disintegrate silently as the caster falls.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: Confirmed hit on the target!

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Great.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: This high-powered energy weapon is capable of blasting a hole open through an armored vehicle, and yet it wasn't able to penetrate her Arts.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: This damned Vouivre and her Arts are tough as shit, harder than power armor.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: You mean to say... There's a possibility she might survive?

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Heh, 'possibility.' I'm so fed up with that word. All those researchers tossing it around.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: What I want is results, definite results.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: Then what happened with the Vice President...

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Maylander won't give us a second chance.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: The op team is still on standby. Should we order them to withdraw?

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: No need. Give them something else to do.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Just like how we dealt with that eyesore of a Vouivre, don't let anyone causing chaos in Rhine get off scot-free.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: It's time for these idiots who think they can do whatever they want with just a few companies under their belts to wake up—

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: No one can challenge the Columbian Army's authority on Columbian soil and get away with it.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Move!

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Blake, I didn't give you Rhine's contacts for you to drag it into the gutter!

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Which is why you've used your channels within Rhine.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: The guilty are often the first to complain, Ferdinand.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Are you aware of our current situation?

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Someone disrupted the intel, and the detonator went off too early.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: And now, reporters have already spun the story that this has nothing to do with Jackson at all.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: What did you say?

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: I said, the assassination failed.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Are you satisfied?

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Come on, Ferdinand. Put away whatever weapon you're hiding.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Do you really think you can even leave a scratch on me?

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Relax, I don't blame you.
Blake pats Ferdinand's cheek twice.
Ferdinand expected Blake's eyes to be filled with a murderous intent, but to his surprise, all he sees is a smile.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Carrying out an assassination within Rhine given our current intel would have been extremely difficult, even without your meddling.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: And even now, that company's all that's on your mind. Loyalty to your own desires isn't necessarily a bad thing, though.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: I'm serious, Ferdinand. It's an admirable trait.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: You're fit to be a soldier.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: But now that we've failed—

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: What of it? This is just the beginning.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: It's a good thing that Maylander has us pinned down. Do you know just how many of my superiors have been waiting ages to strike out against them?

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Before the situation spirals out of control, our losses will only win me more support.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: And if things really spiral—

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Trust me, you don't want to know how things will end for me.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Of course, I can't guarantee how they'll end for you either.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: I'll stick to our agreement, to help you find Kristen.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: We can still turn the tables once we have her in our grasp.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: That goes for the both of us... and Rhine too.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: I'll go meet with Jara.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Sure... by all means.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Let's see if it's luck... or fate, that will catch up to us first.

steps.name: Defense Section Employee?
steps.text: Squad A, search that side.

steps.name: Defense Section Employee?
steps.text: Squad B, conduct your search over here.

steps.name: Defense Section Employee?
steps.text: Our targets are a hooded figure with no weapon, and a Feline girl able to use highly lethal Arts.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Doctor, my terminal lit up.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: That means... it's time for me and Ifrit to meet up, but I can't sense her presence.

options: Rhine should be safe for now.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: This place... isn't safe at all.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: There are too many laboratories here. They all have the same white walls, just like a maze.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Ifrit hates this kind of place the most. Whenever she talks about those memories, her breaths become shorter and her hands get cooler than usual.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I want to go find her. I don't want to see my friend get hurt.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: These walls aren't so tough. Just give me the order and I can get you out of here easily.
Thank you very much for choosing not to smash up our walls. We imported the material from Kazimierz. They're very expensive.
There's no need to be so nervous, little girl. As you can clearly see, I'm only a businessman. Nothing but a fountain pen and a wallet in my pocket.

options: I didn't expect to see you here, Director Fitzroy.

steps.name: Justin Jr.
steps.text: Haha, sure enough. My next meeting just happens to be around the corner, so I figured I would greet our guests on my way over.

steps.name: Defense Section Employee?
steps.text: ...Areas C and D have been searched.

steps.name: Defense Section Employee?
steps.text: There's a ton of conference rooms in front, prepare to check them one by one.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Enemies in the corridors, and a lot of them too.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Give me the order, Doctor.

steps.name: Justin Jr.
steps.text: A hero working behind the scenes to prevent a terrible conspiracy, but soon to become the target of a clandestine arrest.

steps.name: Justin Jr.
steps.text: In Columbia, these sorts of stories are common enough, and such a script wouldn't fetch a good price in Wrankwood.

steps.name: Justin Jr.
steps.text: At the end of the day, is it a party being obstructed by the establishment and wanting to punish them for it, or the other party dispatching a commission to let this yet-to-be-exposed deal sink into the abyss—

steps.name: Justin Jr.
steps.text: What do you think?

options: Seems like there's no need for guesses here.
Surely you showed up here at this moment for more than a greeting?

steps.name: Justin Jr.
steps.text: Oops, would you just look at the time! They're waiting for me to start our meeting.

steps.name: Justin Jr.
steps.text: I hope I haven't disrupted your plans too much just by stalling you a bit?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Doctor, please stand back. I'm going to begin attacking.

steps.name: Justin Jr.
steps.text: My friends call me Justin Jr.

options: The military seeing us together won't be good for you.

steps.name: Justin Jr.
steps.text: What if I told them that the young and beautiful Feline lady by your side has something to do with a top-secret military experiment that should rightfully be covered in dust and long unused?

options: Is that a threat from an enemy?
Is that a reminder from a friend?

steps.name: Justin Jr.
steps.text: The choice lies with you.

steps.name: Justin Jr.
steps.text: Do remind me, just how many of our excellent employees have you already poached from Rhine Lab? Was it eight, or ten?

steps.name: Justin Jr.
steps.text: Jara has been thinking about getting acquainted with whoever runs your HR.

steps.name: Justin Jr.
steps.text: Since Rhodes Island and Rhine Lab have been cooperating so closely—the next time we meet, I might even have a contract for you with an offer you can't refuse.

options: Rhodes Island thanks you for your interest.

steps.name: Justin Jr.
steps.text: Alright, I won't bother you and Miss Feline here any longer. By the way, Dr. {@nickname}, after you get back, please do ask Muelsyse a question for me—

steps.name: Justin Jr.
steps.text: When she goes out to eat, what's her preferred cuisine?

steps.name: Defense Section Employee?
steps.text: Only one conference room left. The target is most likely inside.

steps.name: Defense Section Employee?
steps.text: Prepare to breach.

steps.name: Defense Section Employee?
steps.text: ...It's empty?

steps.name: Justin Jr.
steps.text: Did you hear a sound just now?

steps.name: Defense Section Employee?
steps.text: What sound?

steps.name: Justin Jr.
steps.text: The sound of water. Ah, how wonderful it is.

steps.name: Justin Jr.
steps.text: It's... a lively energy, strong enough to fight even fate itself.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Saria... Saria!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: She's not responding... no way...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Her head's suffered a serious impact, and though her vital signs are there, she's still in critical condition. She needs emergency treatment.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Ifrit, help me lift her arms... ugh, so heavy...

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Don't even think about hurting Saria again!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Silence, I can burn a way out for us, and we can go try and meet up with the Doctor.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: No. The people watching us are definitely also after Rhodes Island.
Yes, the military is already inside Rhine, and your friends might not be able to protect themselves.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Director Jara...?!

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: Come with me, kids.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: I can't just sit by and watch the other founder of Rhine Lab fall here.

steps.name: Vice President's Secretary
steps.text: Mr. Vice President, Congress called back. It's regarding the bill to dismantle those military bases, they're ready to move the hearing up.

steps.name: Vice President's Secretary
steps.text: In addition, the Justice who reached out to us earlier has hinted that she's willing to cooperate with us to overturn the previous ruling.

steps.name: Vice President's Secretary
steps.text: The military is going to pay for their recklessness. We have an optimistic estimate that Colonel Blake will be out of Trimounts within the next twelve hours.

steps.name: Vice President's Secretary
steps.text: Everything is waiting for your decision, sir.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: A call should be coming in, Pavard.

steps.name: Vice President's Secretary
steps.text: Yes, this is the Vice President's temporary office... Yes, he's right next to me... Yes...

steps.name: Vice President's Secretary
steps.text: Mr. Vice President, it's...

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: Hand it over, I know who's looking for me.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: ...Alright.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: I understand. I feel the same. I'm not about to let everyone down at this critical juncture.

steps.name: Vice President's Secretary
steps.text: Mr. Vice President, about the bill...

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: Shelve it. There's no need to put this matter on the agenda for the next six months.

steps.name: Vice President's Secretary
steps.text: Is that... an order from the Maylander Foundation?

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: Pavard, how many casualties were there in that mess from your report?

steps.name: Vice President's Secretary
steps.text: We eliminated thirty military operatives.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: And how much money do we spend on training these soldiers every year?

steps.name: Vice President's Secretary
steps.text: Three million to train a combat-ready man to DOD standards, sir.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: So we basically just lost 90 million in cash and 30 outstanding talents.

steps.name: Vice President's Secretary
steps.text: ...That's right.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: So, there's no need to ask whose orders it is. It's a decision that's in the best interests of Columbia.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: Go get me a meeting with Blake. It's time for us and the DOD to work together.

steps.name: Vice President's Secretary
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: I'll always remember the day the election results came in, when I thought smugly to myself that I could finally sit behind the desk of my dreams—and I received the biggest shock of my life.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: Haha. Back then, I almost thought my country was caught up in a huge conspiracy.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: But I've come to realize that's not what's happening.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: Columbia isn't wrapped up in any conspiracy, and Maylander isn't the shadow government I thought it was.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: It's just silly things happening in an orderly way, that's what makes it seem like we've been making real progress.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: But I'm still just a regular guy. Every now and then, something crazy pops into my head.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: If I really was caught in that explosion, then... would I be remembered as a martyr for Columbia? Or just tossed in the dustbin of history as some incompetent politician?

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: What... do you think?
The Vice President looks around the empty office, as if waiting for the omnipresent air to answer his question.
Then, the man standing so close to the apex of Columbian power sighs.
The military won't be bothering you any longer, so why the long face?

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: ...Ho'olheyak, you are a difficult woman to reach.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Sorry about that. My boss, who I've not seen in a long time, has popped on over to Trimounts. I needed some time to compile my reports.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: I'm afraid the Tin Man has forgot to send me any copies.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: And that's why I've come to answer your question personally. As long as it's something I know, I'm happy to tell all.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: Alright, you're the primary representative for the Maylander Foundation's Rhine Lab desk. So, tell me—

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: Where exactly is the main instigator of all this malarkey? Where is Kristen Wright right now?

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: She's in a place that not even the finest of Columbia's commandos are able to reach, a place never documented by the Maylander Foundation.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: There's nowhere in Columbia like that.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: It's not on any map of the country, at least for now. Even though the location might overlap with our territory, it is truly out of our line of sight.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: So you mean...

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Mr. Vice President, you are no doubt familiar with 'Project Exploration', an archaeological undertaking spanning multiple years led by the Maylander Historical Association... or rather, our Tin Man.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: Those ancient ruins buried under the vast wasteland.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Exactly. Coincidentally, we also came across this information during a recent raid operation on Rhine-related personnel.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: Exploration records?

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: These records are currently in the hands of a former executive of Rhine Lab, a close friend of Kristen Wright's... as well as an offshore company with an existing criminal record in Columbia.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: And it is the most coincidental thing, that this company called Rhodes Island has a working relationship with my dear leader, the Tin Man.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...A water purification and circulation system.

steps.name: Tin Man
steps.text: You could also call it a 'sewage drain.'

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It used to have another name, 'Locus of Sorcery.' Once the most primitive weapons of witchcraft from the Teekaz.

steps.name: Tin Man
steps.text: So that's its actual full name. To think that it was installed on the Pioneer Team's nomadic temporary housing.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Though it's certain that the device's core components have already long been lost.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: All that is left are the outermost pipes, and you people... had a reasonable idea of how to recycle it.

steps.name: Tin Man
steps.text: I will take that as a compliment on behalf of the Columbians, Madame.

steps.name: Tin Man
steps.text: This country has gone through hard times. During the Great Expansion when supplies were scarce, every object was classified into only one of two qualities: useful or useless.

steps.name: Tin Man
steps.text: This may be a medium of some magnificent memories in your eyes, but to the ordinary people living in Columbia, they are useful pipes that will not be rusting anytime soon.

steps.name: Tin Man
steps.text: After all, no matter how old an object is, or how great an era it has seen, those unable to be comprehended by people of the current era will be no different from scrap.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Our own levels of understanding are but restricted by our own time and space. You and I are not exempt either... and the same goes for Kristen Wright.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: She couldn't have drawn her power from a Teekaz-like legacy, and whatever outside force she has borrowed power from is much more powerful than that.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: There are still thirty-two technologies waiting to be ruled out. Most of these are not on the Maylander Historical Association's exploration records.

steps.name: Tin Man
steps.text: I presume you won't be needing my company for whatever is coming next.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Sure enough. But this will not affect our partnership with Maylander.

steps.name: Tin Man
steps.text: Yes, indeed. This has always been your way of going about things.

steps.name: Tin Man
steps.text: You're hoping that Kristen will not get hold of that technology... but you also hope that Columbia won't be able to prematurely pocket that fortune for themselves. Still the same as always... selfless and neutral.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I have one more thing to ask of you.

steps.name: Tin Man
steps.text: We can discuss that first, Madame.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}... and those two girls.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: As you've said, there are some roads that only I can take. I'd like to trouble you to take care of them when it's inconvenient for me to do so.

steps.name: Tin Man
steps.text: Oh, I've misjudged you. You have changed after all, Madame. You're more humane than you once were.

spans.text: changed after all, Madame. You're more humane than you once were.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: No one, or thing is forever unchangeable, Revenant... Mr. Tin Man. All we can do is to accept these changes.
Hey, Doctor, you good?
Hmm, I should rein in the water and not let it enter the respiratory tract...
Or could it be... that my skills have gotten rusty after not using them for so long?
The Doctor probably bumped that hood on something and passed out.
Ahh—so sorry!
It's all cause of that Justin Jr., he suddenly dumped a stack of papers on me, said all the directors have to fill them out or we won't get our funding for next year.
That was close, I almost didn't make it.
Oh, you're awake, Doctor.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Good morning... no, good evening.

options: I remember being in a ventilation duct—

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Yup. I was manipulating my water around when I knew you were in trouble.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: The two of you were about to be discovered when I found you, so I wrapped you up in water and brought you here.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I was in a hurry, so excuse the bumpy ride, 'kay?

options: I can't repay the kindness you've shown me.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: You've saved me once, and now I got you back... Oh, who knows whose turn it'll be next?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Doctor, you're not thinking of how you're gonna repay me, are you?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Um... how about you go shopping with me next time?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: It's not that great a deal, hehe.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: But you know, if you insist on returning the favor, just sign this employment contract I got here! I wouldn't mind having an assistant with brains as big as yours.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Doctor... I know you just woke up, but, I gotta tell you some bad news.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: It seems like Saria got attacked at the same time you were.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I'm not sure about the specifics, but that's Saria, you know? Harder than diamonds! She wouldn't be in any serious danger, right?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: The big question is what you do next. You must've gotten the feeling that once the military gives you a warning, they don't give up so easily.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: So your situation here is... Actually, Rhodes Island's situation is far from hunky-dory.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Iffy should be fine and dandy, but Saria...

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I'm not sure about the specifics, but that's Saria, you know? Harder than diamonds! She wouldn't be in any serious danger, right?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: The big question is what you do next. You must've gotten the feeling that once the military gives you a warning, they don't give up so easily.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: So your situation here is... Actually, Rhodes Island's situation is far from hunky-dory.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Outside...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: The corridor... someone is walking toward us.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: But I was so cautious on the way here, the army couldn't possibly have tailed us that easily.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Or could it be the Maylander guys? Like... Mr. Tin Can and his pets...? Secret agents like to pop up like this, don't they?

options: Rosmontis, is it the Tin Man?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I don't know.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I don't feel anything special... the feeling I'm getting is... um, very normal...

options: Muelsyse, can you take a look around the area?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Hm? You want me to send a few 'eyes' out there? You got it.
Huff...*pant*...finally...
Sorry, am I late?
I wanted to see you as soon as you got to Trimounts. Unfortunately... my work took much longer than expected.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: You're...

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Wait, I remember that mug from the docs... You're Loken Williams?!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Lo...ken?

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Yes. It is I.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: You must have received my letter, Narcissa.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Who is Narcissa?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: My name is Rosmontis. It's my only name.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: You... no matter. What's important is that you've come. To tell the truth, I've been a bit nervous ever since I sent the letter.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: To see that you're willing to meet me... makes me a very happy man.
